description: Update fields on an existing story. Accepts Learning Loop fields (hypothesis, confidence_score, hidden_unknowns, risk_profile) and storyType in addition to the basics. Before updating, call `get_story` to inspect current state, and `get_board_context` if your update relates to a topic that may be governed by a recent team decision. Updates are attributed to the user bound to your API key.

confidence_score.description: How confident we are this delivers value (0-100). Earns trust with peers and calibration-minded leaders.

designFidelity.description: INDTEK-515 — fidelity of the attached design: how the developer should treat it. A designer agent declares this when handing off a design.

epicId.description: Epic ID to link this story to. Set to empty string to unlink.

hidden_unknowns.description: Assumptions or open questions that could invalidate the hypothesis. Earns trust with risk committee / staff engineering.

hypothesis.description: We believe that... — drives Learning Loop AI prompts and earns trust with execs/board.

lane.description: Lane to move the story to (case-insensitive)

owners.description: Story d9541094 — Firebase UIDs of the story's owners. Replaces the existing array (PATCH semantics). Pass `[]` to clear owners. Use this to retroactively assign yourself or a teammate to a story whose owners were dropped before the auto-assign fix landed.

risk_profile.description: Categorizes risk (User, Tech, Market, Compliance, Model_Drift). Earns trust with governance and compliance audiences.

sortOrder.description: Sort order within the lane (lower = higher priority)

state.description: Story state (unstarted, started, finished, delivered, accepted, rejected)

storyType.description: Categorizes the story for filtering and Learning Loop signals (feature, bug, chore, platform).

testPlan.description: Markdown test plan. Updates test_plan field without changing workflow_stage.

name: update_story
